items.name: Export a table to CSV

items.name: Import CSV into a table

items.name: Create a user
items.about: Create a new PostgreSQL user role and grant privileges on the database
items.command: psql --host=localhost --port=5432 --username={{db_user}} --dbname=postgres -c "CREATE USER \"{{new_user}}\" WITH ENCRYPTED PASSWORD '{{new_password}}'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE \"{{new_database}}\" TO \"{{new_user}}\";"

items.name: Enable common extensions
items.about: Enable popular PostgreSQL extensions including uuid-ossp, pgcrypto, and vector
items.command: psql --host=localhost --port=5432 --username={{db_user}} --dbname={{database}} -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto"; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pg_stat_statements"; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "vector";'

items.name: Active queries
items.about: List active connections, running queries, and duration in PostgreSQL
items.command: psql --host=localhost --port=5432 --username={{db_user}} --dbname={{database}} -c "SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS duration, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle' ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 20;"

items.name: Largest tables
items.about: Display top PostgreSQL tables by total size and index size
items.command: psql --host=localhost --port=5432 --username={{db_user}} --dbname={{database}} -c 'SELECT relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) AS data_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid) - pg_relation_size(relid)) AS index_size FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 20;'
